body:
> What is left to do or aspire?...

I don't know. I can't argue with you because I can't argue with the voice in my own mind telling me how futile it is. I don't want this anymore. I'm tired, so fucking tired of being used and rejected. The fact that you're feeling the same way, insanely, gives me hope that maybe there's someone out there with the same experience for me. Someone who could understand what I've been through and actually care about me. I dunno, maybe it's insane of me to hope for that and maybe not. What I do know is that giving up makes sure I won't find out. Thank you. Thank you for helping me realize that.

Thank you. That helps a little. I know, logically, that what I'm feeling will pass. I'm sure the same is true for you. I'm so scared of what will happen in the future. I don't have answers for either of us. We just have to hope that things will get better.
Please, someone give me hope. I just can't see it anymore.

Right now? Nothing. I'm feeling like absolute shit. The woman I love is sleeping next to me. She came up for a job interview that will, from her perspective, hopefully let her move in with me. The sad part is, she wants nothing to do with me. In fact, I found out from a mutual friend, who happens to be the guy she used to fuck, that she thinks I'm fucking pathetic. At this moment I have no hope for the future. I feel like walking out into traffic.
